concurrency_and_state: BossManager.bosses is a CopyOnWriteArrayList; update() uses a reverse-index loop (size()-1 down to 0) with an `if (i < size())` guard, which can skip or revisit elements if removeBoss() runs concurrently from another thread.
All 16 singleton managers in src/managers/boss/ use unsynchronized lazy initialization in gI().

Boss.injured() is synchronized on the Boss instance and mutates nPoint.hp, bossStatus, prepareBom, and playerTarger from skill/combat caller threads, while Boss.update() runs unsynchronized on the boss manager loop thread and reads/writes those same fields.

SieuBoHung.callCellCon() schedules delayed lambdas via GameLoopManager.gI().schedule(..., 2000/4000/6000) that mutate boss statuses asynchronously without checking if SieuBoHung already left map or respawned.
AnTrom.update() reads Client.gI().getPlayers() size and indexes into it without synchronization or snapshot (TOCTOU IndexOutOfBoundsException risk).
Boss.handleBom() iterates zone.mobs and zone.getNotBosses() directly without defensive copies while applying damage/death effects.
cross_module_questions: Does BrolyManager.gI().update() get invoked by GameLoopManager/ServerManager? BrolyManager.start() is a stub printing 'Broly đã spawn (fake).', yet BossManager.loadBoss() spawns 10 Broly instances registered into BrolyManager.

How does Client handle Message(-96) subcommand 0 menu selection for 'Máy Dò Boss', and does the handler call BossManager.getBossByIndex(index)? If so, showListBoss() sends filtered validBosses indices while getBossByIndex() indexes the unfiltered bosses list.

In Player/Points (nPoint), are dameg and hpg still `int` or `long`? XenBoHung.hapThu() casts maxDameAllowed and maxHpAllowed to `(int)`, and multiple Boss subclasses cast `injured()` return values to `(int) damage`.

Does ChangeMapService.exitMap(this) set this.zone = null synchronously? SuperBroly.leaveMap() calls detu.leaveMap() before exitMap(this), which relies on master.zone != this.zone to allow DetuBroly to clean up.

findings.impact: Players killing SieuBoHung via its self-destruct mechanic never receive kill rewards, drops, or Boss task/quest completion credit.
findings.root_cause: SieuBoHung.injured() triggers setBom(plAtt) instead of die(plAtt) when lethal damage is taken; 2500ms later Boss.handleBom() hardcodes `Player plAtt = null; die(plAtt);`, so Boss.die() skips `reward(plKill)` and ServerNotify.
findings.title: SieuBoHung self-destruct (handleBom) passes null killer, skipping reward and quest credit

findings.impact: Clicking a boss in Máy Dò Boss (Boss Radar) teleports/selects the wrong boss or fails because indices do not match.
findings.root_cause: showListBoss() filters `this.bosses` by `isBossTaskMain()` into `validBosses` and writes `validBosses` index `i` into Message(-96), while getBossByIndex(index) indexes the unfiltered `this.bosses` and `BrolyManager.gI().bosses` lists.
findings.title: Index mismatch between showListBoss() and getBossByIndex() breaks Boss Radar selection

findings.impact: SieuBoHung immediately exits AFK back to ACTIVE before its 7 XENCON children finish spawning, fighting players simultaneously during the 6s spawn delay.
findings.root_cause: callCellCon() sets bossStatus = BossStatus.AFK and schedules XENCON1-7 spawn 6000ms later, but autoLeaveMap() runs every update tick and forces `AFK -> ACTIVE` whenever `this.currentLevel > 0` (form 2).
findings.title: SieuBoHung.autoLeaveMap() prematurely cancels AFK state during callCellCon()

findings.impact: Bosses CHILLER and RONG_1_SAO..RONG_7_SAO are never spawned at server startup.
findings.root_cause: loadBoss() calls createBoss() for BossID.CHILLER and BossID.RONG_1_SAO..RONG_7_SAO, but none of these IDs are registered in BOSS_REGISTRY (and RongNhi1Sao..7Sao classes are commented out).
findings.title: Missing BOSS_REGISTRY entries for CHILLER and RONG_1_SAO..7_SAO called by loadBoss()

findings.impact: Can throw IndexOutOfBoundsException in AnTrom.update() on disconnect race, and skip/double-update bosses in BossManager.update().
findings.root_cause: AnTrom.update() reads `players.size()` and then calls `players.get(Util.nextInt(playerCount))` on the live player list without synchronization; BossManager.update() uses reverse index iteration over CopyOnWriteArrayList which is not atomic against concurrent removals.
findings.title: Unsafe concurrent list indexing in AnTrom.update() and BossManager.update()

findings.impact: Boss HP recovery and damage tracking overflow to negative values when damage > 2.68B (Android19) or > Integer.MAX_VALUE (XenBoHung, Broly, BlackGoku, etc.).
findings.root_cause: Android19 casts `(int) ((long) damage * 80 / 100)` before calling hoiPhuc; XenBoHung casts `maxDameAllowed`/`maxHpAllowed` to `(int)` when assigning `dameg`/`hpg`; 7 Boss subclasses cast `long` damage to `(int)` on `return` from `long injured(...)`.
findings.title: Integer truncation/overflow in Android19, XenBoHung, and Boss injured() returns

findings.impact: Exception in dungeon/event boss update() permanently removes the boss from its manager, potentially soft-locking dungeon progression.
findings.root_cause: Six manager subclasses copy-paste an update() loop that calls `removeBoss(boss)` inside `catch (Exception e)` and swallows any exception during removal.
findings.title: Duplicate update() in 6 dungeon boss managers removes boss on transient exception

findings.impact: Potential NullPointerException or ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in DrKore, SieuBoHung, XENCON1-7, Broly, SuperBroly, OngGiaNoel, and Boss.leaveMapNew().
findings.location: src/models/boss/Boss.java:1177-1182 & DrKore.java:96 & SieuBoHung.java:186 & XENCON1.java:33-35 & Broly.java:155,162 & OngGiaNoel.java:67,149
findings.root_cause: Missing null/bounds checks: Boss.leaveMapNew() sets `currentLevel = data.length`; DrKore.doneChatS() skips null check on `bossAppearTogether`; SieuBoHung.mc() skips null check on `zone`; XENCON1-7.joinMap() skips null check on `parentBoss`/`zone`; Broly/OngGiaNoel index `playerSkill.skills` without size validation.
findings.title: Missing null and array bounds checks across Boss FSM and multiple boss subclasses

findings.impact: High maintenance burden and bug replication across duplicate classes (e.g., XENCON1-7, 6 identical BossManager subclasses, commented-out RongNhi1-7 and ChristmasEvent classes).
findings.root_cause: XENCON1-7 duplicate identical reward/joinMap/doneChatE/leaveMap/autoLeaveMap logic differing only by BossID; 6 managers duplicate update(); BrolyManager contains unused fake start/stop/spawnBroly/despawnBroly stubs.
findings.title: Heavy boilerplate duplication and dead stub code in Boss managers and XENCON1-7

findings.impact: DetuBroly remains alive/stuck or cleans up late when SuperBroly leaves map alive due to call ordering in SuperBroly.leaveMap().
findings.root_cause: SuperBroly.leaveMap() invokes `this.detu.leaveMap()` BEFORE `ChangeMapService.gI().exitMap(this)`. DetuBroly.leaveMap() returns early if `!master.isDie() && master.zone == this.zone`.
findings.title: SuperBroly.leaveMap() calls detu.leaveMap() before exiting map, triggering early return guard

key_classes.name: BossManager
key_classes.responsibility: Singleton registry (BOSS_REGISTRY), startup spawner, update loop, and Boss Radar (Message -96) UI builder for bosses.

key_classes.name: Boss
key_classes.responsibility: Base Boss entity extending Player; implements boss FSM (REST/RESPAWN/JOIN_MAP/CHAT_S/AFK/ACTIVE/DIE/CHAT_E/LEAVE_MAP), Last Stand/Berserk/Parry/FlashStep combat engine, and non-blocking bomb mechanic.

key_classes.name: AnTrom
key_classes.responsibility: Wandering thief boss that steals gold from players, flees, and switches non-safe maps periodically.

key_classes.name: Broly
key_classes.responsibility: Scaling world boss that increases HP/damage when hit and spawns SuperBroly upon leaving map.

key_classes.name: SuperBroly
key_classes.responsibility: Upgraded Broly boss spawning DetuBroly companion and rewarding normal Pet or gold/upgrade stones.

key_classes.name: SieuBoHung
key_classes.responsibility: 2-stage Cell boss that summons XENCON1-7 via delayed tasks and triggers self-destruct bomb on fatal blow.

key_classes.name: XenBoHung
key_classes.responsibility: 3-stage Cell boss that periodically teleports to and absorbs a random player in the zone to gain stats.

module_summary: Covers the server boss management layer (BossManager and 15 specialized/event/dungeon manager subclasses in src/managers/boss/), the core Boss FSM & combat base class (Boss.java), AnTrom, and boss_list implementations for Androids (13/14/15/19/DrKore/Pic/Poc/KingKong), BlackGoku, Broly/SuperBroly/DetuBroly, Cell/SieuBoHung/XENCON1-7, OngGiaNoel, plus commented-out RongNhi1-7 and ChristmasEvent stubs.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Subcmd 0 (Máy Dò Boss): UTF title, byte count, then per boss: int index, int index, short head, (if version >= 214: short -1), short body, short leg, UTF name, UTF status, UTF location.
Broadcasts boss bomb charge animation to map: byte(7), int((int) boss.id), short(104), short(2000).
